notes.title: Mr. AMO has arrived!
notes.content:
After a long year producing Mr. AMO and incredibly [b]ALONE[/b], I am honored to announce that it is released and ready for you to enjoy.
There will be future updates, events, additions of many things I have already planned, but that's it for now.
